observations: A large rounded head shape fills most of the canvas against a dark grey-green ground; two mismatched eye forms sit high on the face, one built from concentric teal loops, the other from a golden disc with radiating black lines.
Two thick red horizontal bars cross the upper face, edged with a blue zigzag line; white outline strokes trace the skull and jaw independently of the filled areas beneath them.
The mouth zone is a dark red rectangle enclosing a row of white rectangular blocks outlined in black, sitting below a gap with small black tooth marks along the lower edge.
reading: The face is built from competing systems: concentric teal loops for one eye, a radiating golden disc for the other, so the two sides never quite agree. Red bars cut across the brow as a flat mechanical band, while white outline strokes float free of the grey-green fill beneath them. The boxed mouth, with its row of white blocks, reads less like a scream than a locked grid — the overall mood is tense and compressed.
